source: COMPOSED. Chunk shape per https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/text-generation (streamGenerateContent?alt=sse; each chunk a full GenerateContentResponse with candidates[0].content.parts[{text}], role model, index 0, usageMetadata, modelVersion, same responseId; no finishReason before the last chunk — Agent Platform: 'finishReason … If empty, the model has not stopped generating'). @google/genai v2.27.0 generateContentStream yields each SSE event unmerged (src/_api_client.ts processStreamResponse). Whether usageMetadata on intermediate chunks is cumulative is UNVERIFIED — this fixture makes the LAST chunk authoritative and gives intermediate chunks partial counts on purpose, so a provider that sums chunks fails the test.
